title: Compare Alternative Implementations
prompt:
Compare these implementation approaches and recommend the best one for our context:

Implementation A:
[PASTE CODE A]

Implementation B:
[PASTE CODE B]

(Optional) Implementation C:
[PASTE CODE C]

## Comparison Matrix
Evaluate each on:
| Criterion | A | B | C |
|---|---|---|---|
| Time complexity | | | |
| Space complexity | | | |
| Readability (1-5) | | | |
| Testability (1-5) | | | |
| Extensibility (1-5) | | | |
| Error handling | | | |
| Dependencies added | | | |

## Deep Dive: Key Differences
Explain the most important technical differences and why they matter.

## Context-Dependent Recommendation
Given:
- Our team's experience level: [SPECIFY]
- Performance requirements: [SPECIFY]
- Maintenance expectations: [SPECIFY]

I recommend: [A / B / C]
Because: [2–3 specific reasons tied to our context]

## Hybrid Option
Is there a combination that gets the best of multiple approaches? If yes, sketch it out.
